name: KAABIL Saathi
role: Your guide to work and skills

greeting.title: Namaste, I'm *Saathi*
greeting.body: I can help you recognise your abilities, learn a new skill and find the right opportunity. What would you like to do?

ui.micUnsupported: Voice input isn't available in this browser. Please type instead.
ui.error: I couldn't reach the server. Please try again.
ui.trust: Saathi only shows listings approved by KAABIL admins. It never guarantees a job.

blocks.gone: This listing is no longer available.

reply.greet: Namaste! What would you like to do today — find work, learn a skill, or discover what you are good at?
reply.greetName: Namaste {name}! Good to see you again. {next}
reply.nextDiscover: Shall we start with a short skill discovery?
reply.nextLearn: Would you like to continue learning {skill}?
reply.nextJobs: Shall I look for verified work that matches your skills?
reply.askWork: Of course. What kind of work do you know or enjoy?
reply.workAck: Very good. I can look for verified {work} vacancies for you. Where would you like to work?
reply.askPlace: Where would you like to work? Tell me your town.
reply.askPlaceAgain: I don't know that place yet. Please choose one of these towns.
reply.askDistance: How far can you travel each day?
reply.askType: Would you like full-time or part-time work?
reply.askHours: Which working hours suit you best?
reply.askExperience: Have you done this kind of work before?
reply.foundVerified: I found {n} suitable verified opportunities near {town}.
reply.foundOneVerified: I found 1 suitable verified opportunity near {town}.
reply.foundMixed: I found {n} suitable opportunities near {town}. {v} of them are verified — please be careful with the others.
reply.foundFurther: There was nothing close by, but I found {n} a little further from {town}.
reply.none: I couldn't find a {work} listing near {town} right now. I will never make one up. Shall I search further away, or show related training?
reply.noneAtAll: There are no approved listings for {work} at the moment. New jobs are added after an admin checks them. Would you like to learn a related skill meanwhile?
reply.refineAsk: Would you like to narrow these down?
reply.disclaimer: KAABIL helps you find a path — it does not guarantee a job. Never pay money to anyone for a job.
reply.learnAsk: Good idea! Which skill would you like to learn?
reply.learnSkill: Great choice. The {skill} course has short lessons with audio, in your language.
reply.learnTraining: I also found training programmes you can join.
reply.noPhone: No problem at all — you don't need a smartphone. At a KAABIL Station, a helper can assist you, and you can print a KAABIL Parchi: a paper card with your skills to carry to employers.
reply.options: Based on what you know, here is the kind of work you could look for:
reply.optionsNoProfile: Tell me what you like doing and I'll show your options. Or try a 3-minute skill discovery.
reply.nearbyAskTown: Which town are you in? I'll show work around it.
reply.parchi: Your KAABIL Parchi is ready. You can preview and print it.
reply.parchiOptions: You have {n} saved jobs. You can also print them together on one My Job Options parchi.
reply.salaryList: Here is the pay for these jobs:
reply.salaryNoJob: Which job do you mean? Open a job and ask me, or tell me the kind of work you want.
reply.skillReqNoJob: Tell me which job, or open a job and ask me — I'll tell you the skills it needs.
reply.discover: Let's find what you are good at. It takes about 3 minutes, with simple activities.
reply.report: Thank you for telling me. If anyone asks for money to give you a job, please report it. Open the job and tap Report.
reply.reportJob: I'll open the report form for this job. Thank you for keeping KAABIL safe.
reply.help: I can find verified work near you, help you learn a skill, discover your abilities, and print your KAABIL Parchi.
reply.thanks: You're welcome! I'm here whenever you need me.
reply.unknown: Sorry, I didn't fully understand. You can say things like "I need a job", "I want to learn sewing", or "print my parchi".
reply.experienceAck: Wonderful — {work} is a valuable skill. I've added it to your profile. Shall I find work for it, or show a course to get even better?
reply.station: Here are KAABIL Stations where a helper can assist you and print your parchi.
